title: Merge the report's deviations into trace.deviations at cap time
action:
A worker's structured deviations never reach the knowledge loop. `bee cells cap` writes `trace.deviations` from `--deviations-file` plus the single `--deviation` line only (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/handlers_close.rs:359-369), while the worker's own Result form arrives in `--report` and is stored VERBATIM as `trace.report` (:387-390). `bee knowledge promote` mines pattern candidates from `trace.deviations` alone (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/knowledge/promote.rs:286, consumed at :720-724). So a deviation recorded structurally in the report is invisible to mining, and the field comment at handlers_close.rs:80-88 states the intended remedy outright: the orchestrator is expected to re-type the deviation into `--deviation` by hand so it "carries into the pattern-candidate mining". That hand-copy is the defect. It silently did not happen and cost real knowledge: `.bee/cells/archive/herding-split-serialize/hss-3.json` holds `trace.deviations: []` beside three entries under `trace.report.deviations`, and its feature's promote-proposals.md consequently printed "None: no capped cell trace carries a deviation or a failure signature" over the only genuinely new lesson that feature earned. `docs/knowledge/patterns/20260811-a-cells-declared-file-is-a-hypothesis.md:36-43` predicted exactly this and said it would stay invisible until deviations were recorded structurally.

Fix, entirely inside the cap write path in handlers_close.rs. After the existing `--deviations-file` then `--deviation` append (:362-368) and BEFORE `trace.insert("deviations", ...)` at :369, append every entry of the validated report's own `deviations` array that is not already present in the list being built. Rules:
1. Source the entries from the already-validated report value the same block inserts at :387-390 (`parse_report_flag` has already proven the exact five keys, so `deviations` is present and is an array — do NOT re-validate it, and do NOT re-parse the raw flag string).
2. Append only entries that are non-empty after trimming, pushed trimmed, as `Value::String`.
3. Dedupe by EXACT string equality against what is already in the list (including entries that came from `--deviations-file`, which may be arbitrary JSON values, not only strings — compare only against existing string entries, and never mutate or drop a non-string entry a deviations-file supplied).
4. Order is deviations-file entries, then the `--deviation` line, then the report's entries in their own order. The frd-1 ordering test asserts the first two positions; keep them exactly where they are.
5. Do NOT touch `trace.report` — the D8 verbatim contract at :387-390 stands, and the report keeps its own copy. This cell makes `trace.deviations` the union, never a move.
6. Update the doc comment at :80-88 so it no longer instructs a caller to hand-copy a report deviation into `--deviation`: `--deviation` remains for a deviation the ORCHESTRATOR observed that the worker did not report. Name this cell in the comment.

Tests in the file's existing test module style (see packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/tests.rs around the frd-1 and D8 report cases at :3845-3930): (a) a cap whose report carries deviations and which passes NO `--deviation` puts those report entries into `trace.deviations` — the exact case that lost hss-3's lesson; (b) a cap passing `--deviations-file`, `--deviation` AND a report with its own entries yields all three groups in that documented order; (c) an entry present in both `--deviation` and the report appears exactly ONCE; (d) a report with an empty deviations array leaves `trace.deviations` byte-identical to today's behaviour; (e) `trace.report` is unchanged in every case above — assert it still equals the parsed report verbatim, deviations included.

truths: A deviation a worker records in its report reaches trace.deviations with no hand-copying
The verbatim trace.report object is unchanged by this cell
A cap passing no report deviations behaves exactly as it does today

artifacts.substantive: the dedup-merge before the deviations insert, the corrected --deviation doc comment, and the five tests; no TODO stubs

key_links: trace.deviations is the union of deviations-file, --deviation, and the report's own entries, in that order
prohibitions: No change to trace.report or to parse_report_flag's validation
No change to knowledge/promote.rs — this cell fixes the data at the source, not the reader
No change to the existing order of deviations-file and --deviation entries

trace.outcome: A deviation a worker records in its report now reaches trace.deviations with no hand-copying, in string and non-string form alike, deduped by the same rendering the miner uses.
deviations: Judge raised two residuals across three rounds: a report-side non-string deviation was silently dropped while the same shape from a deviations-file was mined, and the first dedup test passed against the pre-fix code because a skip leaves the same array a dedup does. Both closed and independently reproduced.
trace.friction: The orchestrator called ExitWorktree while a worker was still live in that worktree; a subagent inherits the session cwd, so every subsequent write was refused. Worth a guard or a warning at exit time.

checks.evidence: handlers_close.rs:399-418 holds the merge block; it sits AFTER the --deviation push (:366-369) and BEFORE trace.insert("deviations", Value::Array(deviations)). It reads report_value.get("deviations") from the value bound at :191 by parse_report_flag — no re-parse of the raw flag, no re-validation. Blob at 9255ff8 is 1350db83…, identical to 78677d6c.

The merge only reads and pushes into the local deviations vec; trace.insert("report", report_value.clone()) at handlers_close.rs:423 still stores the parsed object verbatim. parse_report_flag (finish_support.rs:94-190) has no hunk in any of the three commits — its newest commit is b09f6c1e. All SIX dol-1 tests call assert_report_verbatim (tests.rs:3884-3891).

handlers_close.rs:405-412 matches Value::String for trim-and-skip-empty and clones any other shape, then pushes at :415 — never stringified, trimmed, or wrapped. an_object_shaped_report_deviation_passes_through_verbatim (tests.rs:4004-4021) is one of the two tests red on the pre-fix copy. A shapes probe printed null, 7, true, ["a","b"], {}, {"description":""} and a 60-deep nested array all verbatim, order preserved, blank string still dropped.

Covered in BOTH directions by committed tests. String-first: an_object_and_its_rendered_string_are_one_deviation (tests.rs:4037-4057). Object-first: an_object_from_the_file_absorbs_its_rendered_twin_in_the_report (tests.rs:4062-4090), new in 9255ff8 — a deviations-file object plus the report's rendered line plus a fresh line yields [{object}, "fresh line"], so the object keeps its place AND its form. Mechanism is direction-agnostic: :413-415 compares deviation_text(&candidate) against deviation_text(d) for every existing d, so the earlier source always wins.

Reproduced independently by the judge, not relayed. Pristine HEAD tree copied out, handlers_close.rs replaced by git cat-file blob 459225c:…, run by exact name: FAILED, 0 passed, 1 failed, left [Object{type:scope,…}, String("scope: the declared file was a hypothesis"), String("fresh line")] vs right [Object{…}, String("fresh line")] — byte-identical to the orchestrator's own run. This is the direction a skip cannot fake: the object is already in the list from --deviations-file, so pre-fix code has nothing to skip and appends the rendered string beside its own twin. Whole cells filter on that copy: 229 passed, 2 failed, the two being the object-first and pass-through cases.

tests.rs:4024-4036. The removed claim is replaced by an explicit disclaimer: the case does NOT prove the deviation_text dedup on its own, because the pre-dedup code SKIPPED every non-string report entry and a skip leaves behind exactly the array a dedup does; what it locks is a naive pass-through-plus-raw-equality rewrite; the object-FIRST case is the one that goes red without the dedup. Every clause matches measurement — this test passed against 459225c, the object-first one failed.

promote.rs blob is 26b20cec… at BOTH 459225c and 9255ff8 — byte-identical, no hunk anywhere in dol-1. handlers_close.rs:17 borrows the single definition at promote.rs:68-84 via knowledge/mod.rs's pub(crate) re-export. A search over verbs/cells/ returns only the import at :17, the two call sites at :413-414, and one comment at :392 — no copied {type, description} match arms.

Raw blob-to-blob diff of tests.rs (78677d6c to 9255ff8) shows exactly FOUR deleted lines, all doc-comment, and ZERO deleted code — the five earlier dol-1 tests are byte-unmodified. The String arm at handlers_close.rs:406-411 still trims and continues on empty. frd-1's ordering test (tests.rs:3781-3798) is untouched across all three commits and green in both runs.

deviations_file_then_flag_then_report_keep_that_order (tests.rs:3917-3945) pins the five-element order [file-object, file-string, flag, report0, report1]. On the pre-fix copy it printed left [Object{note}, "from the file", "from the flag"] — the first three positions byte-identical pre and post, only the report tail added. The push-only-when-absent structure cannot reorder or rewrite an existing entry.

The Some(Value::Array(reported)) arm iterates zero times on an empty deviations array, and trace.insert("deviations") is unconditional both pre and post, so no key is added or removed. an_empty_report_deviations_array_changes_nothing (tests.rs:3974-3996) passes against the reverted pre-fix build and at HEAD, same expected value under both codepaths.

No panic path: jsjson.rs:117-122 stringify only expects on in-memory serialization and UTF-8, neither reachable from a serde_json::Value, and parse_report_flag's from_str enforces serde_json's default 128 recursion limit (no unbounded_depth feature). Probed green on null, 7, true, an array, {}, {"description":""}, a 60-deep nested array and a whitespace string. Collision benign: {"description":"why"} and {"type":"","description":"why"} both render "why" and collapse correctly, while {"type":"scope","description":"why"} stays separate; no case was found collapsing two genuinely different deviations. Cost is O(n*m) with the largest real report array at 4 entries. Deliberate symmetry, not a defect: a null or {} entry reaches trace.deviations and renders non-empty so promote would mine it, while an empty STRING is dropped — identical to how a --deviations-file entry has always behaved.

handlers_close.rs:79-92. The old hand-copy instruction is replaced: --deviation is now documented as being for a deviation the ORCHESTRATOR observed and the worker did NOT report, because a worker's own structured deviations are merged by cap_cell_from_flags itself, so nobody re-types a report line to get it into the pattern-candidate mining promote.rs reads. The cell is named and frd-1's single-value note is preserved.

git show --name-only 9255ff8 lists cells/tests.rs ONLY. Blob hashes prove byte-identity for the two files that must not move: handlers_close.rs 1350db83… at both 78677d6c and 9255ff8; promote.rs 26b20cec… at both 459225c and 9255ff8. Worktree clean apart from the pre-existing untracked control-plane file; HEAD is 9255ff85 on 78677d6c on 459225c6, stacked, no amend.

The cell's goal is met end to end: a deviation a worker records structurally in --report now reaches trace.deviations with no hand-copying, in both string and non-string form, deduped by the SAME rendering the miner uses, with trace.report left verbatim and frd-1's order intact. Judge's own run of the declared verify on the real tree: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml cells -> 232 passed, 7 ignored, 0 failed. Both residuals raised across three rounds are closed and independently reproduced. No open finding remains.

report.outcome: cap merges the --report Result forms own deviations into trace.deviations as a union (deviations-file, --deviation, then report entries); strings trimmed and empties dropped, any other shape passed through verbatim as a --deviations-file entry always has, deduped by deviation_text borrowed from the miner. trace.report stays verbatim.
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml cells — green (232 passed, 7 ignored, 0 failed) — the suite owning the cap write path and its tests; discrimination proven by reverting handlers_close.rs to 459225c with tests at HEAD, which turns the object-first and pass-through cases red with the exact predicted diffs
deviations: Stacked three commits rather than one per cell: a live judge and a cwd move made amending unsafe mid-flight, and the third commit was a coverage fix the judge required. All three carry the dol-1 trailer.

The second round was verified in a scratchpad copy and landed as a patch, because the orchestrator exited the worktree while the worker was still live and the write guard correctly refused every write into it. The worker did not route around the guard.

Non-string report entries pass through verbatim rather than being skipped or refused - chosen over making parse_report_flag refuse, because a refusal would block a cap mid-flight over a shape that has never occurred in 180 stored entries.
